For each PF-02 negative domain edit the authoritative table field through the product UI
Run Check Readiness and record NOT_READY or METHOD_GAP with field/row/identity context

currentMainFinding.unitMismatch: Tabular quantity parsing preserves arbitrary explicit units and current readiness does not validate source mass-flow unit, while the numerical kernel rejects units outside kg/s and kg/h.
currentMainFinding.pressureOrderingMismatch: Current readiness validates pressure positivity/reference evidence but not resolved upstream > downstream ordering; the kernel rejects non-positive pressure drop.

uiGate.finding: Run Screening requires readiness counts with readyForQualification > 0, notReady=0, methodGap=0, plus current assumption acceptance.

requestBuilder.finding: Workspace request construction requires a readiness-qualified envelope and fails if NOT_READY or METHOD_GAP blockers exist.

readiness.finding: Readiness validates many evidence/domain conditions but does not share all numerical executable-domain checks such as supported source units and resolved pressure ordering.

registeredAdapter.finding: validateInput checks non-empty tables/topology, inventory attestations and assumption profile but does not invoke buildAivReadiness or a shared PF-02 executable contract.

currentCalculator.finding: Screening delegates to numerical kernel stages without first asserting the same readiness contract.

kernel.finding: Kernel explicitly enforces supported units and p1>p2 among other executable-domain checks.

registeredEngine.finding: Shared engine calls definition validation before definition.calculate; existing AIV-specific hooks remain sufficient in principle, so no shared-engine change is justified without live reproduction.
